description: Hold TypeScript on 6.x. Next.js 16 loads the TypeScript compiler API directly and rejects the 7.x native port at build time: 'TypeScript 7.0.2 does not provide the compiler API required by Next.js. Enable experimental.useTypeScriptCli in your Next.js config to use the TypeScript CLI, or install TypeScript 6 instead.'
This breaks `next build` and the test job — not just typecheck — so it cannot be merged and re-fixed later.
Lift this once Next.js supports the TS 7 compiler API, or once we opt into experimental.useTypeScriptCli and verify a full build.
